be_off.label: BE + costs (BE at entry + 1.25 -> plain BE at entry)

cisd1m.label: 1m CISD step (limit fill at the CISD level instead)

window.label: 02:00-15:30 entry window (-> 01:00-15:55, all the detector sees)

one_day.label: 1 trade a day (-> up to 5, one at a time)

t_check_be_off.label: no 15-min check and plain BE (= the 2026-10-18 rules)

lvl.label: next level target (PD / PW / PM high-low)

vix_lvl.label: nearest of VIX band or a PD / PW / PM level

vix_fb4.label: VIX band, else a fixed 4R (no skip)

buf0.label: stop exactly at the sweep extreme
